text: The goalkeeper is the only player allowed to handle the ball, and only inside their own penalty area.
A corner kick is awarded when the ball crosses the goal line after last touching a defender.
Wingers stretch the defense by staying wide and delivering crosses into the box for the striker.
A yellow card is a caution, and a second yellow in the same match results in a red card and a sending off.
The World Cup is held every four years and brings together national teams from every continent.
Clubs in European leagues can be relegated to a lower division if they finish near the bottom of the table.
A through ball splits two defenders and lets a forward run onto it behind the back line.
Center-backs win headers, block shots, and organize the defensive line to keep it compact.
A free kick from the edge of the box is often curled over the wall and toward the top corner.
Possession-based teams pass patiently through midfield, waiting for gaps to open in a tired defense.
The video assistant referee reviews goals, penalties, and red cards to correct clear errors.
A hat trick means a single player scored three goals in one match.
A pitcher throws from the mound, and the batter tries to hit the ball into fair territory.
Three strikes make an out, while four balls let the batter walk to first base.
A home run is hit over the outfield fence, letting the batter and all runners score.
The catcher calls pitches with hand signals and frames close pitches to earn strike calls.
A double play records two outs on one batted ball, often from shortstop to second to first.
Starting pitchers usually work every fifth day, with relievers covering the late innings.
A stolen base happens when a runner advances while the pitcher delivers the ball to the plate.
The World Series is the championship played between the winners of the American and National Leagues.
Batting average divides hits by at-bats, while on-base percentage also counts walks.
A curveball breaks downward as it approaches the plate because of the topspin applied by the pitcher.
A sacrifice bunt gives up an out to move a runner into scoring position.
Each team gets nine innings, with three outs per half inning.
The wavefunction assigns a complex amplitude to every possible state of a quantum system.
The Schrödinger equation describes how a wavefunction evolves in time.
Electrons in an atom occupy discrete energy levels rather than any arbitrary energy.
The double-slit experiment shows interference even when particles are sent through one at a time.
Spin is an intrinsic form of angular momentum that takes only quantized values.
The Pauli exclusion principle forbids two identical fermions from occupying the same quantum state.
Photons carry energy proportional to their frequency, as explained by Planck's constant.
Decoherence describes how interaction with the environment suppresses quantum interference.
A qubit can be represented as a point on the Bloch sphere.
Bell's theorem shows that no local hidden-variable theory can reproduce all quantum predictions.
Operators on a Hilbert space represent observable quantities such as energy and momentum.
Quantum field theory treats particles as excitations of underlying fields.
